source_selection: Curated from already retained public-source assessments; not a fresh exhaustive crawl

theses.title: Diverse starting answers, not just louder debate
theses.work_basis: Authors study diversity-aware initialization and confidence-modulated debate.
theses.ghostmesh_problem: Confidently wrong agreement across multiple reviewers
theses.complementarity: Independent initial-answer diversity may challenge consensus before cross-agent critique.
theses.counterevidence: The paper does not demonstrate independent evidence collection; GhostMesh operates on sourced editorial records rather than benchmark QA.
theses.experiment: Equal token-budget evaluation on 30 already sourced claims: independent vote, ordinary debate, diversity-selected debate; score correctness, false confidence and cost.

theses.title: Skill interoperability without trust inheritance
theses.work_basis: Agent Skills uses a folder with SKILL.md and optional supporting code; its governance is being moved to a foundation.
theses.ghostmesh_problem: Moving deterministic skills between diverse agent runtimes without weakening execution controls
theses.complementarity: Public schema compatibility could reduce special adapters while retaining GhostMesh's own trust and permissions.
theses.counterevidence: Standardized packaging does not establish secure execution or imported trust; GhostMesh may already conform to most of the format.
theses.experiment: Offline schema diff against existing skill packages, three invalid/hostile fixture bundles, no installer or privileged runtime.

theses.title: Keep competing interpretations visible
theses.work_basis: Conceptual collaborative sensemaking model with attribution and layered personal/shared interpretations.
theses.ghostmesh_problem: Readers need to see why an editorial conclusion changed and which dissenting interpretations remain.
theses.complementarity: Research could inform a clearer provenance and dissent interface if baseline usability is actually inadequate.
theses.counterevidence: Conceptual framework rather than validated implementation; existing GhostMesh history and claim-impact views may already satisfy this.
theses.experiment: Twelve fixed histories comparing current Readers/Scout presentation with minimal source → interpretation → decision view; measure attribution errors and correction retrieval time.

theses.title: Vocabulary efficiency for repetitive local outputs
theses.work_basis: Cost-weighted vocabulary specialization for a repeated structured-output task, with author-reported controlled variants.
theses.ghostmesh_problem: Local agent workflows can spend inference time on repetitive structured output.
theses.complementarity: May point to a focused optimization path where local telemetry shows high output-token fragmentation.
theses.counterevidence: The reported savings are for one specialized task and model; retraining/tokenizer incompatibility and semantic loss may outweigh any benefit.
theses.experiment: First profile a frozen representative output corpus and serving latency without changing Qwen; only consider expendable-model specialization if estimated benefit is material.

theses.title: Failure archives and strategic intervention
theses.work_basis: The authors propose speculation, consolidation of successes/failures, and selective stronger-model navigation.
theses.ghostmesh_problem: Repeated approaches and unclear model escalation value in multi-agent research
theses.complementarity: Durable failed-attempt memory and explicit escalation accounting could reduce repeated work.
theses.counterevidence: Our synthetic pilots revealed cost sensitivity, misleading feedback, and delayed-breakthrough losses. Program search differs from authorized infrastructure work.
theses.experiment: Do not adopt from toy results. Sample 10 real de-identified research decisions with existing receipts; assess recurring failure modes and decision costs before any model trial.

theses.title: CPython repository documentation
theses.work_basis: Upstream project documentation covers building and using the Python implementation.
theses.ghostmesh_problem: General implementation dependencies are not inherently collaboration opportunities.
theses.counterevidence: A repository's technical importance is not evidence of an unusual GhostMesh collaboration thesis.
theses.experiment: None; retain as a negative control.
